verdict.rationale: Restate documents first-party integrations for the Vercel AI SDK and the OpenAI Agents SDK, which give fault-tolerant agent execution with automatic retries and durable state. Its docs say "a few lines turn your agent into a durable agent" and that LLM calls and tool steps are persisted and recovered after failures, so the core story is delivered without custom glue. missing for 10: explicit model-provider-level integrations, evidence of a broader range of agent frameworks beyond these two SDKs, in-depth integration documentation detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the integrations work as claimed.
